input.descriptionHtml:
SALE PENDING

Ask about our available deferred interest financing!


Unleash Your Inner Explorer:

The Hobie Mirage Revolution 13 is a masterpiece of nautical design, blending efficiency, stability, and speed seamlessly.
Crafted with flowing, liquid lines, it offers a seaworthy performance without sacrificing speed. Get ready for your next aquatic adventure!

Feature-Rich Fishing Companion:

Loaded with dual rod holders and generous tackle storage, it's perfect for anglers seeking the catch of a lifetime.
Experience the MirageDrive 180, offering both forward and reverse pedal power.

Maximum Comfort and Adjustability:

Designed for your comfort, the Revolution 13 boasts Hobie's premium Vantage CT seating, easily adjustable to your preference.
Stay organized with ample storage options to keep your gear secure and dry, whether you're on a fishing expedition or simply exploring.

Ready for Any Challenge:

Navigate twisty and challenging courses with ease; the Revolution 13 loves an adventure.
Equipped with an accessory mount, this lightweight, rotomolded hull can be powered by our optional Sail kit for an exhilarating experience.
Add the optional bimini for maximum sunshade on those sunny days.

Specifications:

Crew Capacity: 1
Drive: MD 180
Length: 13 feet 5 inches
Width: 28.5 inches
Capacity: 350 lbs
Vantage CT Seat Capacity: 275 lbs
Fitted Hull Weight: 70.5 lbs
Fully Rigged Weight: 88 lbs
Hull Construction: Rotomolded Polyethylene
Height from Floor to Middle of the Kayak: 11.25 inches
Height from Floor to Tallest Point on the Kayak: 14.25 inches

Embark on unforgettable aquatic journeys with the Hobie Mirage Revolution 13. Whether you're a fishing enthusiast or an adventure seeker, this kayak offers the perfect blend of performance, comfort, and versatility. Explore the waters like never before and make your next expedition an extraordinary one with the Hobie Mirage Revolution 13!
